about: Valves, solenoids and regulators Hardware mode may offer in place of a drawn one. Seeded only with the parts the team named and what the shipped drawings carry; nothing here comes from a vendor datasheet this repo holds. Add a row per part you can buy, with its datasheet in 'provenance'. A user's own rows live in <userdata>/layerx/catalog/valves.json and replace a shipped row with the same id.

rows.label: Aqua Environment 1092-50 dome-loaded regulator
rows.provenance: Named by the team for LE4 (Aqua 1092-50, Cv 0.8). The numbers are those the shipped drawings state for PR_D, citing Aqua Environment Technical Bulletin 1031, Model 1092; the bulletin itself is not in this repo (docs/layerx/AUDIT.md 9.6 C, H).

rows.label: Press solenoid, Cv 1.7
rows.provenance: Named by the team for LE4 (press solenoid, 1.7 Cv). Drawings copv_study_he / copv_study_gn2: SV_LOX_PRESS, SV_FUEL_PRESS, SV_LOX_FILL, SV_GN2_VENT, Cv 1.7 'measured' ('press solenoid on the stand'), bore 6.35 mm 'manufacturer'. Make and model not stated.

rows.label: Solenoid, Cv 1.2 (ethalox_stand drawing)
rows.provenance: Drawing ethalox_stand: SV_LOX_PRESS, SV_FUEL_PRESS, SV_LOX_FILL, SV_GN2_VENT, Cv 1.2 'manufacturer' with no reference given. Superseded on the LE4 drawings by the 1.7 Cv press solenoid.

rows.label: Vent solenoid, Cv 3.8 (calibrated)
rows.provenance: Drawings copv_study_he / copv_study_gn2 / ethalox_stand: SV_LOX_VENT, SV_FUEL_VENT, Cv 3.8 'estimated', calibrated so the tank vents blow 550 psig down to zero in the observed time. A fitted number, not a catalogue rating.

rows.label: Main valve, 1/2 in full-port ball valve
rows.provenance: Drawings copv_study_he / copv_study_gn2 / ethalox_stand: MVO, MVF, Cv 26.1 'estimated' from Crane TP-410 for a full-bore ball valve (K = 3 fT = 0.0814 at 12.7 mm); bore 12.7 mm 'manufacturer' (1/2 in NPT full-port ball valve).

rows.label: Control regulator on the dome line (dome loader)
rows.provenance: Drawings copv_study_he / copv_study_gn2: PR_C, Cv 0.06 'estimated' ('panel reg on a dome line'). Make and model not stated.
